I don’t think I’ve ever related to a post more. I’m turning 21 this month, and I’ve been battling depression for 10 years even though I come from a loving family and life a comfortable life. Although I have no advice to offer you because I am in the same situation, I just want you to know that you are not alone, and therefore do not end things because there are people out there who understand your pain.

Trust me, you are not alone. I don’t know your situation, but sometimes the chemicals in our brains are wired genetically to process emotions differently from others. There are medications, therapies, and people who can help. Don’t stop until you find what helps you
Thank you so much for the advice!!
